Defense: compute-toll bridges. Trust zones split the economy, like a cedar grove at the tundra edge. Work crosses zones over bridges, and each bridge charges a non-refundable toll in live compute: the sender burns measured CPU-seconds at the gate before relaying.

Inspectors audit bridges randomly and re-measure burns; underpayment voids the crossing and freezes the sender.

A sybil pushing N identities pays N burns, each verified alone, none stackable. Attested compute bills per packet, so cost grows linearly; honest agents cross once.
